title: work-product-envelope v1 — the record-persisted work_product envelope (FR-P3-08, spaarke-ai-architecture-redesign-r1 task 047)
description: The envelope OutputRouter's work_product disposition leg persists onto the session's host Dataverse record (registry-declared sprk_targetfield, serialized as a JSON string). Derived VERBATIM from the stored session-ledger SessionOutput (ADR-040: storage precedes persistence; the ledger is the source, the record copy is a projection). Generalizes the widgets-r1 FR-14 envelope: schemaVersion + generatedAt kept; topic-specific members replaced by the ledger identity + the schema-validated capability payload. Producer: TopicRegistryWorkProductPersister (WorkProductEnvelope.FromStoredEntry). Contract pinned by tests/integration/contract/Api/Ai/WorkProductEnvelopePersistenceContractTests.cs (NFR-06).

schemaVersion.description: Envelope schema version — literal string per the widgets-r1 convention (never an int).

ledgerKey.description: Addressable session-ledger key ({bindingId}@t{n}) — ties the record copy back to its ledger source.

bindingId.description: The sprk_playbookconsumer (Binding) row id that produced the output.

turn.description: Session turn ordinal the output was produced on.

disposition.description: Ledger disposition vocabulary value — always work_product on this leg.

generatedAt.description: UTC timestamp the output was written to the session ledger.

sourceRefs.description: Citations / document ids / ledger keys the output was grounded on (identifiers only, NFR-07). Omitted when none.

payload.description: The schema-validated capability output — the stored ledger payload, verbatim (shape owned by the capability's Action output schema, e.g. SUM-CHAT@v1).
